title: Remote viewing Napoleon's 'War of the Rabbits'
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Remote viewing Napoleon's 'War of the Rabbits', about early 19th century (target) at France (target), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: as the carriage went away he was throwing rabbits out the window. He lost the war to the rabbits.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer, meaning someone trained to perceive hidden people and events with the mind, says he once viewed a scene from the life of Napoleon, the French emperor of the early 1800s. According to Buchanan, he saw Napoleon riding away in a carriage, throwing rabbits out of the window, and says Napoleon "lost the war to the rabbits."
